title: Window Hopper - Support secondary key combination (alternate keyboard language)

status.label: Clear multilingual hotkey design candidate
status.detail: The report identifies layout switching as the reason one Window Hopper shortcut cannot be used consistently.

next_action.label: Design alternate activation shortcuts
next_action.reason: The requested secondary shortcut behavior and layout-switching scenario are concrete.

actions.label: Design secondary Window Hopper shortcut
actions.note: Define storage, validation, conflict handling, and runtime matching for a second activation shortcut across keyboard layouts. This drafts no upstream mutation.

judgment.rationale: The feature request gives a specific accessibility/workflow problem and a bounded solution: one alternate Window Hopper hotkey.
evidence: The user switches between US and UK keyboard layouts.
Their selected grave-accent activation does not continue to work after switching layouts.
Keyboard Manager cannot provide the alternate remap because it reports an invalid remapping cycle.
judgment.recommended_action: Design an optional second Window Hopper activation shortcut with layout-aware validation and conflict handling.
